sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model from Supertone. Runs on CPU via ONNX Runtime. No GPU. No cloud. No API. 31 languages.

sources.title: Supertone Releases Supertonic v3: On-Device Text-to-Speech Model with ...
sources.snippet: Supertone released Supertonic 3, the third generation of its on-device, ONNX-based text-to-speech system. Supertonic 3 ships with 31-language support, improved reading accuracy, fewer repeat and skip failures, and v2-compatible public ONNX assets.
